title: A Small Gift for the Youngest Member of the Crew
description:
Today marks the first anniversary of the Astral Express' reembarking.
Time flies. I still remember the first time we met, when you, March, and Dan Heng rescued Arlan from the Voidrangers. The situation was dire, but you were still bantering joyfully. At that moment, I thought to myself, perhaps this gray-haired kid would make a good Nameless.
In the blink of an eye, we have experienced so much together. I am glad to have witnessed your growth.
The road ahead is still long. But keep in mind, there are many people by your side who will support and protect you. Including me, of course.
Let's continue trailblazing together!

Pom-Pom's note:
Trailblazer! Happy one-year anniversary! Don't forget to log in and claim your rewards before 2024/05/07 17:00. The email is valid for 30 days. Oh, and remember, your Trailblaze Level should be Level 4 and higher.

Proposal from Dr. Ratio
description:
Pardon the interruption — you are now speaking with Veritas Ratio.
It has come to my attention that your broadcast today touched on certain warp arrangements in connection with myself. If I may be so bold...
The current arrangements for this Warp are pitiful! Zero points!
The dissemination and sharing of knowledge, as well as truth, is imperative. I, in my esteemed capacity, demand that every trailblazer be given access to a proper education! With lessons delivered by me in person!
I have said my piece. That is all. Farewell.
